title: Make the drain source check judge model behavior against pinned code
summary: The drain's page source check (`check_study_text` in pin.rs, called from drain.rs) only verifies per-statement claims and quoted text. I read the request as: extend it so the check that ends drain also compares the study's model (states, transitions, counters, rules, waivers) with what the pinned code does, and fails on behavior errors and on contradictions within the page. The audience is the maintainer, and the independent reader who rates the page.

defaults_applied.how: New tests cover the added problem kind and the drain refusing 'target met' on a behavior problem; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Criteria check that a behavior error in a model fails the check and holds back 'target met', not merely that a prompt string exists.
The fix is in the check that ends drain, not in correcting the three listed errors in one study.
Doc comments, CHANGELOG and decisions entry are written for an outside reader.
One focused change to the source check and its prompt, schema and tests.
The verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
The criteria target the outcome, which is that the gate rejects a model whose behavior differs from the pinned code.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: the check that gates 'target met' in drain must catch behavior errors in the study model (wrong end state after reopen, counter not freed by a failed close, rule contradicting a waiver), not only quote existence. The audience is the maintainer and the independent reader who rates the page.

Chosen approach: keep one model call per study, but rewrite SOURCE_CHECK_PROMPT and source_check_brief in crates/athena-core/src/pin.rs to require tracing each model.json state, transition, counter and rule through the pinned code, and cross-checking rules on the page against each other. The prompt must also say what counts as a behavior error. Add a problem kind such as 'behavior' or 'inconsistent' to the checker schema and to its handling.
The existing model-free floor (model_contradictions in drain.rs) stays. It may gain a check for the red-PR/waiver kind of self-contradiction only if that can be done mechanically.
Tests use the fake agent, so a new unit/integration test shows a behavior-kind problem fails check_page and the drain does not report target met. No live model is run.
Prompt-version bump (Component version) and a decisions.md entry and CHANGELOG line are expected for the changed behavior; athena.toml and defaults.toml are unchanged.
Higher cost per check is possible because the checker reads more; the existing verifier cap and the budget reserve still apply.

acceptance_criteria.text: SOURCE_CHECK_PROMPT and source_check_brief in crates/athena-core/src/pin.rs instruct the checker to trace the study's model (states and where transitions end, counters and every event that changes them, rules and their waivers) through the pinned code, and to report a model that behaves differently from the code or a page that contradicts itself. The report schema has a problem kind for this, and it is distinct from 'contradicted' and 'omitted'.

The drain.rs module docs, the CHANGELOG and docs/decisions.md describe that the source check now judges model behavior against the pinned code, and why. The reason cited is the repeated 4-vs-3 score gap and the three named errors: reopen shown as finished, the counter freed by a failed close, and a red-PR rule contradicting a waiver.

Run `cargo test`. A new test using the fake agent returns a behavior-kind problem from the checker, and shows check_study_text reports it as a problem. A drain test shows that the run does not report 'target met' and that Report::held_back names the statement. The test fails if the new kind is ignored.
Run `cargo test`. A test shows the checker's report is still rejected when it omits model.json from files_checked, so the model file cannot be skipped.
Run `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`. Both are clean, and the existing drain and pin tests still pass.

out_of_scope: Correcting the studies' content (the reopened item, the counter, the red-PR rule) in studies/.
Changing the audience rater or its target rating.
Running a live model check against the real pinned repository.
departures: Cost and time sit above the reference. The change touches the prompt, the schema, drain tests and docs, and the fake-agent tests are fiddly. The behavior judgment itself cannot be exercised without a live model, so the verifier can only test the plumbing.
